sources._scrape_skipped_reason: The roofing library's primary entries are https://firefly-cd.vercel.app/ and https://owlroofing.com/, and the library's own note_url_fragility field designates the local template directory as the structural source of truth. astro-templates/owl/ is present locally and is the canonical structure for this build, so re-scraping the references would have produced no token this build uses — brand colors from owlroofing.com must never be cloned, and the structure is already in hand. Saved ~$0.04. Palette and typography below are derived from the CLIENT's own detected brand tokens, which is the intended source anyway.

palette_rationale: Graphite steel base with an industrial amber accent. The accent is refined from #FAB702, the primary brand color Firecrawl detected on the client's own site, nudged to #f2a900 for contrast headroom. The client's existing site is generic-theme blue (#3498DB) which is the WordPress demo's color, not a brand asset — deliberately dropped. Dark bands use #23282e (graphite, reads as machined steel) rather than owl's default olive, which is wrong for an industrial coater. Chrome/silver from the PMP logo is a metallic, not a flat hue, so it is expressed through photography and the graphite base rather than as a token.

contrast_audit._method: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance, computed not estimated.
contrast_audit.verdict: All pairs clear WCAG AA. Raw --color-accent (#f2a900) measures only 1.86:1 on --color-bg and must never be used as body or eyebrow text on a light background — use --color-accent-ink (#8f5e00) there, per the owl template's documented light-bg/dark-panel rule. On the dark #23282e bands the raw accent is correct at 7.39:1.

typography._rationale: Montserrat is BOTH the owl template default and the heading font Firecrawl detected on the client's existing site — a genuine match, kept. The client's body font is PT Sans; Source Sans 3 is its closest well-maintained Google Fonts humanist-sans sibling with a fuller weight range and better small-size rendering for the dense technical spec copy this site carries. Keeping PT Sans is also acceptable if the operator prefers strict fidelity.

section_styling_hints: Lead with capability numbers as typographic elements — part dimensions, weight capacity, gun count. Set them large in Montserrat; they are this business's most persuasive content.
Dark graphite bands (#23282e) for the process/why-choose sections read as machined steel and suit the vertical.
Use the client's real facility photography — aerial plant shot, tractor trailer, blast tunnel, onsite lab, fastener close-ups. Never substitute generic industrial stock.
Spec lists and sub-services should render as dense, scannable bullet columns; the buyer is qualifying, not browsing.
Amber used sparingly and structurally — CTA fills, rules, eyebrow marks — not as a wash.
avoid: generic industrial stock photography (hardhat closeup, handshake, sparks-flying welder)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number
randomized section order — use the fixed owl order
the generic theme blue #3498DB from the client's current site — it is the WordPress demo's color, not a brand asset
star ratings, review counts, or aggregateRating schema — GBP rating is 2.7/7 and is suppressed sitewide
fabricated testimonials — there are zero real ones available
placeholder team headshots — the client's existing 'photos' are theme placeholder letters
consumer home-services register (financing banners, homeowner trust badges, 'family owned since' as the lead) — the buyer here is an engineer or purchasing agent
